title: Emberwild — Detailed Forest Art Study
coordinate_convention: Blender: +X north/up, -Y east/right, Z up. Unreal: X=blender_x*100, Y=-blender_y*100, Z=blender_z*100; +X north/up, +Y east/right.

validation.method: 1m grid; continuous forest mass cells + 0.6m player clearance; no UE NavMesh simulation

art_validation.method: Original path centerlines and spawn/camp markers against evaluated wall meshes; not gameplay testing
